overview.title: The Seasonal Lake of Merzouga
overview.p1: Seasonal lake that can draw flamingos after rains. Dayet Srji rewards a slow visit: look at the water reflections, migratory birds and how wildlife thrives on the edge of the desert.
overview.p2: Water levels vary depending on recent rainfall. Confirm conditions locally on arrival and keep plans flexible around daytime heat.

q1.question: How long do I need at Dayet Srji?
q1.answer: Most visitors spend between 30 to 45 minutes observing the lake and birdlife.

q2.question: Is there an entrance fee for Dayet Srji?
q2.answer: No, Dayet Srji is a natural seasonal wetland and is free to visit.

q3.question: When is the best time to visit Dayet Srji?
q3.answer: Mornings are cooler and ideal for birdwatching, while late afternoons offer wonderful warm light.

q4.question: Will I always see flamingos at the lake?
q4.answer: Flamingos and water birds depend entirely on seasonal rainfall; during dry periods, the lakebed can be completely dry.

q5.question: How do I get to Dayet Srji from Merzouga?
q5.answer: The lake is located a few kilometers from Merzouga village and is easily reached by 4x4, quad bike, or on a guided desert tour.
